description: Defines core service management classes, including ServiceAdministrator, SinkType, ServiceType, and related macros for interface mapping and registration within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing service instances, libraries, and callbacks within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: SinkType
classes.description: Template class implementing reference counting and destruction logic for sink objects.

classes.name: ServiceType
classes.description: Template class managing service object lifecycle, library locking, and interface creation.

classes.name: IService
classes.description: Interface for service objects, providing methods for creating interfaces, retrieving metadata, and linking to other services.

classes.name: IService::IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for service metadata, providing version, name, and module information.

classes.name: PublishedMetadataType
classes.description: Template class implementing IService::IMetadata for published services, encapsulating version and identification info.

classes.name: PublishedServiceType
classes.description: Template class implementing IService for published services, managing creation and interface querying.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Decrements the service instance count and triggers callback if set.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback object for service events.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service interface.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a specific interface of a service.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next service in the linked list.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Provides interface querying based on interface ID.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for sink objects.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for sink objects.

methods.name: WaitReleased
methods.description: Waits until the sink object is released or timeout occurs.

methods.name: LockLibrary
methods.description: Locks the library reference for the service.

methods.name: Destructed
methods.description: Called before object destruction to release library.
